title: ChatGPT Work Tool and Skill Reference
summary: A reference site created by Simon W documenting ChatGPT work tools and skills, providing structured guidance on utilizing AI capabilities for practical tasks. The site aggregates and organizes information about available AI-powered tools and their applications.
problem_solved: Helps users discover and understand available ChatGPT work tools and skills in one organized reference location.
why_valuable: Provides curated, well-organized reference material that saves time for users learning to leverage ChatGPT's expanding tool ecosystem.
